description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractEntityConditionCache used for caching entity conditions in the OFBiz framework. It manages cache retrieval, insertion, removal, and cache invalidation logic for entity conditions and related entities.

classes.name: AbstractEntityConditionCache
classes.description: An abstract cache class for entity conditions, parameterized with key and value types, providing cache management and invalidation methods.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value for a given entity, condition, and key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache for a specific entity, condition, and key, respecting the entity's caching policy.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes all cache entries related to a specific entity.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries for a specific entity and condition.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific cache entry identified by entity, condition, and key.

methods.name: getConditionKey
methods.description: Returns the condition itself as the cache key.

methods.name: getFrozenConditionKey
methods.description: Returns a frozen (immutable) version of the condition for use as a cache key.

methods.name: getConditionCache
methods.description: Retrieves the cache map for a specific entity and condition.

methods.name: getOrCreateConditionCache
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the cache map for a specific entity and condition.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Checks if a map value is null or represents a null entity/value.

methods.name: getModelCheckValid
methods.description: Validates and retrieves the model entity for given old and new entities.

methods.name: storeHook
methods.description: Updates cache entries based on entity changes, with overloads for different parameters.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an entity to a list of view value maps for a target entity.

methods.name: storeHook
methods.description: Main method to update cache entries based on entity change, conditions, and view conversions.

methods.name: <T1, T2> storeHook
methods.description: Handles cache invalidation for a list of old and new values based on conditions.
